about: Throughput per operation of a native developer image on hbox, tmpfs, one unit (tools/throughput_gate.py); quiet says whether each source run had the box to itself. A run fails a metric above max(value * (1 + tolerance), value + floor). value is the smaller of the qualified release's and dev's figure (a ratchet: an improvement lowers it at the next write); both are kept beside it, and a dev figure over the release's limit needs a row in planning/throughput-causes.json.
